Package neqsim.process.equipment.reactor.digestion

Class FirstOrderHydrolysisDigestionModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.reactor.digestion.EmpiricalYieldDigestionModel
neqsim.process.equipment.reactor.digestion.FirstOrderHydrolysisDigestionModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, AnaerobicDigestionModel
Direct Known Subclasses:
CalibratedFirstOrderHydrolysisDigestionModel
public class FirstOrderHydrolysisDigestionModel extends EmpiricalYieldDigestionModel
Engineering screening model with first-order hydrolysis and a bounded temperature correction.

The model calculates volatile-solids destruction as X = Xmax * (1 - exp(-k * theta)) * fT. It represents residence-time and feed-preparation effects without claiming the acid-base, inhibition, or population detail of a full anaerobic-digestion state model.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim team
